connectors.name: Identfy Business Wallet
connectors.description: Identfy Business Wallet is an enterprise-grade organizational identity solution designed for managing, issuing and presenting corporate verifiable credentials in B2B and B2G environments. It provides a scalable, production-ready platform for handling business credentials such as licenses, powers of attorney, certificates and registry-based attributes, while enabling secure presentation to third parties with verifiable trust. Integrated through REST APIs and wallet connectors, the solution supports flexible on-premise and cloud deployments and combines HSM-backed operations, role-based access control, encryption and traceability to meet demanding enterprise and public-sector requirements. It is aligned with the European digital identity ecosystem, including EUDI and EU Business Wallet scenarios.
